propositions: Define and retain a documentation ownership policy covering eight roles with audience, purpose, lifecycle, canonical source, citations, correction, and exclusions for each category.
Restore writing rules and protected forms guidance as non-enforceable authoring guidance without deterministic validators, gates, or prose enforcement mechanisms.
Relocate generated-artifact inventory from docs/README.md to docs/generated-artifacts.md with all catalog entries, regeneration commands, and enforcement gates preserved.
Add explicit policy pointers in AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and docs/README.md that describe the guidance as authoring rather than deterministic enforcement.
Preserve ticket events as append-only records and ADR decision substance through annotations, errata, supersession, or replacement without erasure.
